description:
Execution boundary: planning approved; this issue does not authorize commits, pushes, merges, upstream publication, GitHub comments, live WhatsApp access, or real messages. Revalidate current source/Git state before implementation. Preserve unrelated work, including the already-edited docs/architecture.md. Track this work in the ZAQ Beadwork store even when files belong to the sibling package; do not initialize another store.
Read AGENTS.md in the affected repository. For ZAQ read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the domain policies listed below. Read module documentation before editing. Source navigation uses Serena with bounded fallback if unavailable. Record test results honestly; plan approval is not completed-feature UX approval. Follow repository validation owners; no assertion weakening or unrelated refactors. Existing test changes outside the specifically approved contracts need human approval.

Required domain policies: DESIGN.md; docs/bo-components.md; docs/phoenix.md; docs/services/bo-auth.md; docs/services/channels.md.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
ZAQ owner lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live.ex, existing ChannelEnablePolicy and UI components only where required. Route WhatsApp enable through NodeRouter Event :enable_channel_connector from zaq-e5z.7; remove direct Repo mutation/runtime coordination for that journey. Preserve other providers' established toggles. Use explicit enable intent, scoped descriptor/revision and trusted BO actor; obtain any context through the Engine boundary rather than constructing hidden authorization from socket assigns.
Reflect the approved super-admin restriction in control availability and reject forged/stale LiveView events through the server Action. A non-super-admin click/event leaves connector disabled and makes no runtime or QR request. Preserve super-admin behavior: same saved connector/profile opens its connection modal only after successful runtime sync; valid saved session shows connected; cleared session yields QR; no duplicate connector/binding. On startup failure retain saved enabled/runtime-pending state and actionable feedback; do not report ready or auto-open a successful connection. Close preserves running saved connection, retry targets same account. Reuse existing flash, modal and shared components without visual redesign.
Approved test change: test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live_test.exs "WhatsApp enable cannot expose QR to an unprivileged operator" currently asserts enabled=true; change it to assert remains disabled, no runtime start and no QR. Keep separate authorized success coverage. Broader existing test behavior changes require disclosure.

Tests to add before implementation:
Add/update focused LiveView tests before production edits: super-admin enable calls Engine flow, same-profile QR and connected-without-QR states, non-super-admin denial including direct render_hook/event, stale/missing/archived config, Engine unavailable, persistence/runtime-pending errors, no duplicate runtime on replay, close/retry behavior, unrelated adapter toggle regression. Existing browser tests may run; new/expanded browser journey authoring only through zaq-0l7.8 after zaq-0l7.7.

Branches/paths validated:
Permitted/denied UI and forged events, success/pending/error, same connector on relink, retry/close/repeated enable, provider isolation.

Mocking plan:
Real LiveView, NodeRouter, Engine authorization and Repo integration where possible; external adapter transport fixtures only. Use existing dependency injection, no global config contamination.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before BO edits; update behavior docs and existing E2E issue scenarios. No new design-system styling/assets or layout changes.

Action reuse assessment:
Decision: reuse new EnableChannelConnector via NodeRouter, existing ChannelEnablePolicy.after_enable, LinkedDeviceUI and standard flash/components. Local presentation remains BO-owned; persistence/runtime orchestration is Engine-owned. Direct Repo toggle is rejected for this journey. New Action prerequisite zaq-e5z.7 must be complete before wiring. Verify consumers use shared operation and denied actors cannot mutate via forged event. No new tool/workflow exposure.

comments.text: WhatsApp disabled->enable now obtains Engine context and sends explicit enable event using trusted BO actor. Persistence/runtime result remain Engine-owned; UI refreshes exact connector and opens connection modal only on successful sync. Other provider toggle paths unchanged. Updated only preapproved non-super-admin enable expectation to reject with zero runtime effects; reproduced failure before wiring. Existing BO/onboarding/UI suites: 91 tests pass. mix q passed.

title: [zaq-e5z.8] PR #847 point 4: wire WhatsApp enable UI to authorized Engine operation
